aboutGame.title: Run a nostalgic electronics repair shop
paragraphs: ReStory is a single-player shop-management simulation set in mid-2000s Tokyo. You disassemble, clean, repair and customize nostalgic devices while managing orders, parts and money.
Customer conversations shape their stories and your shop. Long-term goals include Steam achievements, licenses, marketplace work and assembly competitions across 29 documented devices.

footer.about: ReStory Repair Desk is an independent fan guide for repairing devices, growing the shop and completing the game. It is not affiliated with Mandragora, tinyBuild, Valve or Steam.
